theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_linear_algebra_basics
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ (a a' : Rn n) (b b' : Rn ℓ), graphPoint (a + a') (b + b') = graphPoint a b + graphPoint a' b') ∧ (∀ (a a' : Rn n) (b b' : Rn ℓ), graphPoint (a - a') (b - b') = graphPoint a b - graphPoint a' b') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), graphPoint (t • a) (t • b) = t • graphPoint a b) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), ‖graphPoint a b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), (rotatedPlane q).starProjection (q (graphPoint a b)) = q (graphPoint a (0 : Rn ℓ))) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), infDist (q (graphPoint a b)) (rotatedPlane q : Set (Amb n ℓ)) = ‖b‖) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (rotatedPlane q) = n ∧ (∀ (m k : ℕ) (M N : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), 0 ≤ hsNormSq M ∧ hsNorm M ^ 2 = hsNormSq M ∧ hsNormSq (M + N) ≤ 2 * hsNormSq M + 2 * hsNormSq N ∧ hsNormSq (-M) = hsNormSq M ∧ (hsNormSq M = 0 → M = 0) ∧ ‖M‖ ≤ hsNorm M ∧ hsNorm M ≤ Real.sqrt m * ‖M‖) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), hsNormSq K.starProjection ≤ m
